run_f_gold: run f_gold to count non-negative integral solutions where i + j + k equals n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which brute-forces triplets to find solutions summing to n
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the O(n^3) brute-force with an O(1) combinatorial formula
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function and main test harness for correctness and performance
